## Linear Content

A technical blog exploring machine learning, natural language processing, and data science through the lens of mathematical foundations.

### Focus Areas

- **NLP**: Making machines read so I don't have to
- **Stats & ML**: Interesting applications, questionable utility, intuition included
- **Markets & Investing**: Because money, code and text mix well together
- **Occasional Musings**: Random thoughts, powered by LLMs

### Philosophy

Every complex system can be understood through its linear approximations. This blog distills technical concepts into their essential components.
